items.title: Aviation bomb hoaxes leave airlines facing uninsurable disruption costs
items.summary: Recent malicious bomb threats across European flights have exposed coverage gaps, as standard aviation and travel policies typically exclude disruption costs from hoaxes.

items.title: Gallagher appoints Alex Peake to lead UK and Ireland warranty and indemnity team
items.summary: Gallagher has appointed Alex Peake as Head of Warranty and Indemnity for the UK and Ireland within its Private Equity and M&A practice.

items.title: Ardonagh and Gallagher announce senior leadership and operational changes
items.summary: Recent insurance industry appointments include new chief financial and operating officers at Ardonagh's Orvia Underwriting and a planned UK COO handover at Gallagher.

items.title: Ardonagh appoints Orvia Underwriting executives as Gallagher plans COO succession
items.summary: Insurance Business UK reports on leadership changes across Ardonagh, Gallagher, AXA XL, Arch, and The Fidelis Partnership.

items.title: UK insurance broker M&A drops to two deals in October as expected Budget rush fails to materialise
items.summary: MarshBerry data shows October deal volumes tied a ten-year monthly low after the capital gains tax rate remained unchanged.

items.title: Westfield Specialty international arm grows gross premiums 28.8% to $867m
items.summary: Westfield Specialty International expanded its footprint into Europe and new lines during the first nine months of 2026.
